text:
Which is the most effective precaution to reduce the risk when handling, storing or using a
radioactive source that emits γ-rays?
A
Handle the source for the least possible time.
B
Have a fire extinguisher nearby when using the source.
C
Store the source at a low temperature.
D
Wear plastic safety goggles when handling the source.

options.label: A
options.text: Handle the source for the least possible time.

options.label: B
options.text: Have a fire extinguisher nearby when using the source.

options.label: C
options.text: Store the source at a low temperature.

options.label: D
options.text: Wear plastic safety goggles when handling the source.
